rama.name: Edi Rama
rama.role: Albanian prime minister; central figure in the investment decisions, diplomacy and government response covered here.

photo.caption: Edi Rama, 29 February 2024.
photo.credit: Eriona Çami / European Commission, © European Union

gov.name: Government
gov.role: Albanian executive institutions responsible for the public decisions and official accounts cited here.

parl.name: Parliament
parl.role: Albania’s legislature; parliamentary votes require their own primary records.

kushner.name: Jared Kushner
kushner.role: Investor and founder of Affinity Partners; linked by reporting to the proposed Albanian coastal developments.

affinity.name: Affinity Partners
affinity.role: Investment firm founded by Jared Kushner. Distinguish the firm from each project company and its ownership.

sazan.name: Sazan Island
sazan.role: Albanian island and former military site at the centre of a proposed resort. Strategic status does not establish a land sale.

zvernec.name: Zvërnec
zvernec.role: Coastal area near Vlorë and the Narta lagoon; development and environmental questions are separate from Sazan’s.

photo.caption: Narta lagoon meeting the Adriatic near Zvërnec, 7 July 2016. Context photograph, not a cadastral boundary.

alex.name: Alex Soros
alex.role: Philanthropy figure discussed in the public-relationship and Soros-family threads. Friendship is not evidence of financial control.

george.name: George Soros
george.role: Philanthropist associated with Open Society foundations; distinguish foundation grants from personal or political payments.

roth.name: Yacht meeting · identity disputed
roth.role: Reported 2021 yacht encounter. The host’s identity remains unresolved in this dossier; no individual portrait is assigned.

erdogan.name: Erdoğan
erdogan.role: Turkish political leader included in the official-diplomacy thread.

bektashi.name: Bektashi proposal
bektashi.role: Proposal for a sovereign Bektashi entity in Tirana; a proposal is not an established state or a coastal property transfer.

aadf.name: AADF
aadf.role: Albanian-American Development Foundation; published funder of the Vlorë Jewish Museum project.

museum.name: Jewish Museum
museum.role: Vlorë Jewish Museum project; cultural funding and project procurement are separate questions.

balluku.name: Belinda Balluku
balluku.role: Former deputy prime minister and infrastructure minister discussed in procurement proceedings. She denies wrongdoing; charges are not convictions.

photo.caption: Belinda Balluku, 5 July 2021.
photo.credit: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

spak.name: SPAK
spak.role: Albania’s special anti-corruption prosecution structure. Its allegations and procedural statements are not court verdicts.

pif.name: Saudi PIF
pif.role: Saudi Public Investment Fund; reported backing of Affinity is distinct from ownership of a particular Albanian project.

kurti.name: Albin Kurti
kurti.role: Kosovo political leader included in the bilateral-meeting thread.

vucic.name: Aleksandar Vučić
vucic.role: Serbian political leader included in regional diplomacy and Open Balkan coverage.

meloni.name: Giorgia Meloni
meloni.role: Italian political leader included in bilateral cooperation and the migration-agreement thread.

mitsotakis.name: Kyriakos Mitsotakis
mitsotakis.role: Greek political leader included in bilateral diplomacy and disputes.

kovacevski.name: North Macedonia leadership
kovacevski.role: North Macedonian leadership represented in the historical Open Balkan diplomacy thread.

trump.name: Donald Trump
trump.role: US political figure and Kushner’s father-in-law; political proximity alone does not establish project ownership.

students.name: Student organisers
students.role: Student organisers and participants described in protest reporting; not a single registered organisation.

flamingo.name: Flamingo activists
flamingo.role: Environmental activists associated with the coastal-development protests; the movement includes different participants.

opposition.name: Democratic Party
opposition.role: The Democratic Party’s reported support for demonstrations does not establish control or financing of student organisers.

qatar.name: Al-Khayyat investors
qatar.role: Al-Khayyat investors identified in project reporting. Individual investors must not be equated with the Qatari state.

police.name: Albanian police
police.role: Albanian police in reporting on demonstrations, clashes and investigations; specific actions require incident-level evidence.

media.name: Independent journalists
media.role: Independent journalists reporting on the movement; coverage is not proof of organising or financing it.
